title: Qdrant (SKVector) Metrics (Placeholder - Create custom dashboard)
description:
This is a placeholder dashboard. To enable:
1. Check if Qdrant exposes Prometheus metrics endpoint
2. Uncomment qdrant job in prometheus.yml.j2 if metrics available
3. Create custom dashboard using Qdrant metrics
4. Recommended metrics (if available):
   - Collection stats: qdrant_collections_*
   - Query performance: qdrant_query_*
   - Storage usage: qdrant_storage_*
